item.title: Version 1.0.4
item.description: A real ball flight through the hidden stretch: the line crests near the middle and comes down under gravity instead of creeping and rushing the landing. Two clicks go further on long irons filmed from behind. Lines stay locked to the scene through a punch-in. The editor marks every frame the ball was seen in.

item.title: Version 1.0.3
item.description: Smoother apex that follows the ball (Apex menu: Rounded or Exact), a new Opacity slider, better tracking of small far-away balls on the way down, and the fade-out tracer now forms right off the tee.

item.title: Version 1.0.2
item.description: The app now updates itself: future versions install from inside the app. New black app icon.
